sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fix the "Save Table Data" dialog (`showSaveDialog`) and the shared "File Metadata" table it and the Load dialog both use (`buildMetaBlockHTML`) rendering unstyled on /account/applications — same CSP `style-src` issue as WIP.1-4. `buildMetaBlockHTML`'s 10 attributes moved to a new shared, id-guarded `GM_addStyle()` stylesheet, including replacing an inline `${modeColor}`-interpolated background with two static modifier classes (`.sa-meta-mode-multi`/`.sa-meta-mode-single`) since the value is always one of exactly two options. `showSaveDialog`'s own 13 attributes moved to a dedicated, id-guarded, injected-once stylesheet (its interpolated values are settings-only, unchanged without a page reload).

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fix the "Load from Disk" dialog (`showLoadFilterDialog`) rendering completely unstyled/stacked on /account/applications on its very first open — same CSP `style-src` issue as WIP.1-3, this time in the dialog's own 49 `innerHTML`-embedded `style="..."` attributes (dialog shell) plus its internal duplicate of `createFilterHistoryWidget`'s history-dropdown code, which was rewired to reuse the exact same shared `.mb-fhw-*` classes from WIP.3 instead of duplicating them. The dialog shell itself got its own dedicated, id-guarded `GM_addStyle()` stylesheet, safe to inject once since its interpolated dynamic values (font sizes, dropdown height) only change via a settings save, which reloads the page anyway.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fix `createFilterHistoryWidget()` (the Pin/History dropdown attached to every filter input, including the global filter built during initial page load) rendering unstyled if opened on /account/applications — same CSP `style-src` issue as WIP.1/WIP.2, found via console errors present on initial page load even though nothing looked visibly broken yet (the dropdown panel stays `display:none` until clicked). Converted its 11 `innerHTML`-embedded `style="..."` attributes to a shared, page-global `GM_addStyle()` stylesheet (guarded by id so it's only injected once regardless of how many filter inputs get a history widget). Also replaced two single-letter mnemonic underline spans (`<span style="text-decoration:underline">`) with plain `<u>` tags — no CSS needed. Also fixed one missed leftover from WIP.1's `initSaUnicodeCharsFeature` conversion: a separate inline `style="text-align:right"` on the picker's Close row that wasn't part of the `<style>` block originally converted. NOTE: an identical duplicated `_histGlyphs` badge-rendering block still exists un-fixed inside `showLoadFilterDialog` (one of the still-deferred functions, see debug/NOTES.md) — left alone per the incremental fix-as-you-test approach.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Fix the settings/configuration dialog and the changelog viewer rendering broken on /account/applications (unstyled, stacked layout) by fixing the same CSP `style-src` issue as WIP.1, this time in the shared `VZ_MBLibrary.user.js` library (`@require`d by this script): the dialog shells and per-row setting widgets were built via `container.innerHTML` templates with ~75 inline `style="..."` attributes, which are blocked by page CSP the same as `<style>` elements. Converted to id/class selectors targeted by `GM_addStyle()`-injected stylesheets, plus added `// @grant GM_addStyle` to both `VZ_MBLibrary.user.js` and `MB_PageEnhancer.user.js` (the other consumer of this library) so `GM_addStyle` exists in their sandbox. Also replaced an `onfocus`/`onblur` inline event-handler pair in the changelog search box with a CSS `:focus` rule (also CSP-restricted). NOTE: the same `innerHTML`+`style="..."` pattern still exists in ~20 more functions within ShowAllEntityData.user.js itself (dialogs, tooltips, stats panel — see debug/NOTES.md) and will be fixed incrementally as each is found broken during further pageType testing.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: Replace all 9 direct `document.createElement('style')` + `document.head.appendChild()` CSS injection sites (edit-diff table colors, sticky table headers, export/save/load dialog hover states, sidebar toggle, main toolbar chrome, relationships-icon column, Unicode character picker) with `GM_addStyle()` so injected CSS is exempt from Content-Security-Policy `style-src` restrictions (no `unsafe-inline`) that MusicBrainz's backend applies to /account/* pages. This was silently dropping these stylesheets on /account/applications, causing a raw Unicode picker dump appended below the page footer and the sub-table filter row's Cc/Rx/Ex checkboxes stacking one-per-line instead of inline.
